canonicalBaseline.note: Upstream CI at the same HEAD never reached the suite: its verify-boundary gate died at guard:fk-policy (uncommitted generated doc), and its secret-scan was also red. The 34 failures below were therefore invisible upstream.

classifications.rootCause: buildLocalBareDescriptor() probes bwrapAvailable(); macOS hosts have no bubblewrap, so isolation degrades to null and the plane fail-closes with runtime_constraint where the tests expect permission_denied / successful exec. Secure direction (deny), Linux+bwrap is the covered environment.
classifications.fix: ci.yml installs bubblewrap + ripgrep on ubuntu-latest before the suite; these 33 run and assert the real paths in CI.

classifications.rootCause: Asserts existsSync(docs/device-runtime-v3.md); the file was never committed upstream (not tracked, not ignored, no history). Every fresh clone fails this test.
classifications.fix: Present-only guard mirroring the file's existing submodule pattern; path resolution (the named contract) remains asserted unconditionally.

environmentNotes: node 26 (dev host default) additionally fails 5 downloadToBufferWithLimit tests: npm undici@5 dispatcher passed to node-26 built-in fetch raises 'invalid onError method'. Node 22 is the CI toolchain and the supported combo (ADR-0001).
Without a reachable Redis, module-scope ioredis clients retry forever and the suite hangs (run 2, ~40min stall). CI provides a redis service container.
guard:fk-policy fails on fresh clones: docs/fk-policy.generated.md untracked upstream; committed in Phase 0 (content-identical regeneration).
npm >= 11 needs --allow-remote/--allow-git escapes for the xlsx CDN tarball and the libsignal git dep (WhatsApp transport, INV-S1).
